nodes.description: HiFiswapPair reentrancy guard flag, 1 when unlocked and 0 while a guarded function executes.
External swap entry point guarded by lock; optimistically transfers outputs, calls the callee hook, then enforces the K invariant and updates reserves.
Locked liquidity mint that reads pair balances, computes liquidity and mints LP tokens.
Locked liquidity burn that transfers underlying tokens out proportional to LP balance before refreshing reserves.
Locked function that force-transfers excess token balances to an arbitrary recipient.
Locked function that forces reserves to match current token balances via _update.
Private helper performing a low-level token.call with selector transfer(address,uint256) and checking the returned success/data.
Private reserve/timestamp updater that accumulates TWAP prices and writes reserve0/reserve1/blockTimestampLast.
Private protocol-fee minter reading feeTo from the factory and kLast/totalSupply from the pair.
One-time token address setter restricted to the factory address, with only a msg.sender == factory check.
EIP-2612 permit that validates a deadline against block.timestamp, consumes a nonce and applies an approval from an ecrecover signature.
Allowance-consuming transfer that decrements the caller allowance unless it equals uint(-1).
Pair factory entry point that orders tokens, deploys a pair with create2, initializes it and populates the pair mappings.
Privileged setter of feeTo restricted by msg.sender == feeToSetter.
Privileged setter of feeToSetter restricted by msg.sender == feeToSetter.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization checks and forwarded to external callbacks.
Miner-influenceable timestamp used for price accrual, permit expiry and reserve bookkeeping.
Low-level token.call in _safeTransfer that transfers execution control to an arbitrary token contract.
Signature recovery in permit using user-supplied v, r and s values.
Inline-assembly create2 deployment of the pair bytecode in createPair.
uint32 subtraction blockTimestamp - blockTimestampLast in _update that intentionally relies on wrap-around arithmetic.
Cached reserve of token0, held in a packed storage slot.
Cached reserve of token1, held in a packed storage slot.
Last accumulation timestamp stored as uint32 in the packed reserve slot.
Cumulative price accumulator of token0 used for TWAP oracles.
Last recorded product of reserves used for protocol fee calculation.
Total LP token supply, updated by _mint and _burn.
LP balance mapping, mutated by _mint, _burn and _transfer and used by burn for pro-rata payouts.
Nested allowance mapping, mutated by _approve and consumed by transferFrom and permit.
Factory address of the pair, also the only authorized caller of initialize.
Address of the first underlying token of the pair.
Address of the second underlying token of the pair.
Factory-controlled recipient of protocol fees, read by _mintFee.
Factory administrator address required for privileged setters.
Per-owner permit nonce mapping, incremented on every successful permit.
Reentrancy-guard modifier that requires unlocked == 1, sets it to 0 and restores it to 1 afterwards.
Overflow-safe subtraction library helper requiring the result to be <= x.
Attacker-controlled recipient of swap output tokens and target of the HiFiswapCall callback.
Caller-supplied amount of token0 to send out in swap.
Caller-supplied amount of token1 to send out in swap.
Caller-supplied calldata that, when non-empty, triggers the external HiFiswapCall hook.
Derived token0 input amount computed from the post-transfer balance in swap.
Derived token1 input amount computed from the post-transfer balance in swap.
Signer-supplied owner whose nonce is consumed and whose allowance is granted in permit.
Caller-supplied signature expiry compared against block.timestamp in permit.
First token address supplied to createPair before canonical ordering.
Second token address supplied to createPair before canonical ordering.
Recipient address of newly minted LP tokens in mint.
New protocol fee recipient supplied to the privileged setFeeTo setter.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument in the external HiFiswapCall hook invoked by swap.
setFeeTo authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against feeToSetter.
setFeeToSetter authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against feeToSetter.
initialize only checks msg.sender == factory before setting token0 and token1.
block.timestamp determines timeElapsed that drives TWAP price accrual in _update.
permit validity depends on the miner-influenceable block.timestamp relative to the deadline.
The timestamp is reduced modulo 2**32 and subtracted from blockTimestampLast, entrusting arithmetic to the miner-controlled clock.
swap optimistically invokes _safeTransfer for outputs before re-reading pair balances.
burn sends both underlying tokens out through _safeTransfer.
skim force-transfers excess balances to the caller-supplied recipient via _safeTransfer.
_safeTransfer performs a low-level token.call that hands control to an arbitrary token contract while the pair still holds balances.
swap executes external calls (token transfers and the HiFiswapCall hook) before reserves are reconciled.
swap is decorated with the lock modifier that serializes execution.
mint is decorated with the lock modifier that serializes execution.
burn is decorated with the lock modifier that serializes execution.
skim is decorated with the lock modifier that serializes execution.
sync is decorated with the lock modifier that serializes execution.
The lock modifier reads and toggles the unlocked flag to reject nested calls.
swap calls _update after the K invariant check to reconcile reserves.
mint calls _update after minting LP tokens.
burn calls _update after burning LP tokens and paying out underlying tokens.
sync pushes the current token balances into _update.
_update overwrites reserve0 with the supplied balance0.
_update overwrites reserve1 with the supplied balance1.
_update writes the current timestamp into blockTimestampLast.
_update accumulates time-weighted prices into price0CumulativeLast.
The wrap-around elapsed-time computation feeds the value stored in blockTimestampLast.
permit passes user-supplied v, r and s into ecrecover.
A successfully recovered signature lets permit grant an arbitrary allowance for the owner.
permit reads and increments nonces[owner] inside the signed digest computation.
transferFrom decrements the nested allowance mapping unless it is set to uint(-1).
transferFrom moves LP balances between the from and to accounts.
createPair deploys the pair contract using inline-assembly create2 with a salt derived from the token pair.
_mintFee reads feeTo through the factory to decide whether protocol fees are enabled.
_mintFee reads kLast to compute growth in sqrt(k).
_mintFee reads totalSupply when computing the fee liquidity to mint.
rootK.sub(rootKLast) relies on SafeMath to prevent underflow when k shrinks.
mint computes amount0 = balance0.sub(_reserve0) through SafeMath.
burn derives payout amounts from balances and totalSupply, relying on SafeMath guards.
mint calls _mintFee before computing the liquidity to mint.
burn calls _mintFee before computing the payout amounts.
mint caches totalSupply to compute pro-rata liquidity.
burn uses totalSupply to compute the pro-rata share of balances.
mint credits the LP balance of the recipient through _mint.
The caller-supplied swap.to recipient is used for transfers and as the callback target in swap.
swap.amount0Out controls how much token0 is optimistically transferred out.
swap.amount1Out controls how much token1 is optimistically transferred out.
Non-empty swap.data triggers the external HiFiswapCall hook inside swap.
swap.amount0In is derived from the balance delta and feeds the K invariant check.
swap.amount1In is derived from the balance delta and feeds the K invariant check.
The swap recipient is passed as the 'to' argument of _safeTransfer.
permit.owner is committed into the signed digest, its nonce consumed and its allowance granted.
permit.deadline is both signed and compared against block.timestamp.
createPair.tokenA is ordered, validated and hashed into the create2 salt.
createPair.tokenB is ordered, validated and hashed into the create2 salt.
mint.to receives the newly minted LP liquidity.
setFeeTo._feeTo becomes the new protocol fee recipient after the access-control check.
token0 is supplied as the token address argument when _safeTransfer is invoked.
token1 is supplied as the token address argument when _safeTransfer is invoked.
createPair records the factory identity that the deployed pair will later trust in initialize.

normalization_plan.reason: swap.to is only meaningful as the output recipient and callback target inside swap.
swap.amount0Out is an argument that only parameterizes the token0 transfer inside swap.
swap.amount1Out is an argument that only parameterizes the token1 transfer inside swap.
swap.data is an argument that only decides whether swap performs the external HiFiswapCall hook.
swap.amount0In is a swap-local quantity computed from the balance delta and consumed by the K check.
swap.amount1In is a swap-local quantity computed from the balance delta and consumed by the K check.
permit.owner exists only as the signed account whose nonce and allowance permit manipulates.
permit.deadline exists only as the expiry check inside permit.
createPair.tokenA is an argument used solely for ordering, validation and salt derivation in createPair.
createPair.tokenB is an argument used solely for ordering, validation and salt derivation in createPair.
mint.to is the recipient argument used only by the minting operation in mint.
setFeeTo._feeTo is the value written by the privileged setter after the msg.sender check.
